description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.32 each), restores HP (85) to all allies, grants [Regenga] to all allies, grants [Attach Water], [Awoken Kindred] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Awoken Kindred
description.text: Summoning abilities don't consume uses, Summoning abilities, casts Friendship Crystal after using a Summoning ability trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Friendship Crystal
description.text: Restores HP (10/15/25/35/45) at rank 1/2/3/4/5 of the triggering ability, damages undead

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%
